definitions.explanation: An organized group that engages in illegal activities such as drug trafficking, fraud, extortion, or other crimes. Can refer to both domestic groups like yakuza and international criminal networks.

examples.japanese: {犯罪組織|はんざいそしき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{摘発|てきはつ}→摘発：12935_tekihatsu⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国際的|こくさいてき}→国際的：06457_kokusaiteki⟧な{犯罪組織|はんざいそしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}めている→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: The police are advancing their investigation of an international criminal organization.

examples.japanese: {犯罪組織|はんざいそしき}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資金|しきん}→資金：09937_shikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|た}つ→断つ：27885_tatsu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{制定|せいてい}→制定：11907_seitei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: New legislation was enacted to cut off the flow of funds to criminal organizations.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{犯罪|はんざい}→犯罪：03569_hanzai⟧ (crime) and ⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧ (organization). This is the standard formal and legal term for organized crime groups. Used extensively in news reports, police announcements, and legal documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {犯罪組織|はんざいそしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{壊滅|かいめつ}→壊滅：12103_kaimetsu⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧: to destroy a criminal organization
- {犯罪組織|はんざいそしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関与|かんよ}→関与：08646_kanyo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be involved with a criminal organization
- {犯罪組織|はんざいそしき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{構成員|こうせいいん}→構成員：15240_kouseiin⟧: member of a criminal organization
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{犯罪組織|はんざいそしき}: international crime syndicate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{暴力団|ぼうりょくだん}→暴力団：13025_bouryokudan⟧: yakuza, violent group — the legal/official term for Japanese organized crime groups
- マフィア: mafia — loanword, typically refers to foreign crime groups
- ⟦{裏社会|うらしゃかい}→裏社会：26945_urashakai⟧: underworld — broader term for the criminal world as a whole
- ⟦ギャング→ギャング：27073_gyangu⟧: gang — loanword, often used for street-level criminal groups
